title: 25 AI tools you can't ignore in 2026
blurb: A rapid-fire directory spanning search, video, code, design, music, marketing and agents.
body:
A curated grab-bag of AI tools worth knowing, by category of use:

Search & research

Perplexity.ai (solves anything) · Fastread.io (ebooks) · Bibley.io (Bible study)

Video & thumbnails

Syllaby.io (viral videos) · Skysnail.io (YouTube thumbnails) · Submagic.co (long→shorts) · Heygen.com (AI avatars)

Code & build

Replit.com (writes & runs code) · V0.dev (frontend mockups) · Manus.im ("ultimate AI agent")

Design & brand

Canva.com · Brandbutler.ai · Adcreative.ai · Gemini/NanoBanana (photo editing)

Music & audio

Soundraw.io · Suno.com

Marketing & growth

Ranked.ai (rank on Google/ChatGPT/Claude) · Threadmaster.ai · Sociableai.io · Webinarkit.com · Yoinkit.ai · Hellowarrant.com (marketing compliance)

Personal

Resumeenhance.com · askcoachken.com

SOURCE · Austin Armstrong (CEO of Syllaby), LinkedIn.
